'''Naxxar Lions Football Club''' is a professional [[association football|football]] club from the town of [[Naxxar]] in northern [[Malta]].

Their historical and arch-rivals are [[Mosta FC]]. A match between [[Naxxar Lions]] and [[Mosta FC]], is known as the derby of the north, but because there are other derbies in northern Malta it is also known as the Northern Classic.{{Citation needed|reason=Reliable source needed for the whole sentence|date=October 2022}}"}}
